description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler class, verifying its behavior in handling call log searches, permission checks, JSON parsing, filtering, pagination, and error handling in an Android environment using Kotlin and JUnit.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a single call log entry with fields for phone number, name, date, duration, and type.

classes.name: FakeCallLogDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of CallLogDataSource used in testing, providing configurable permissions, search results, and failure modes.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly rejects a call log search request when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests that invalid JSON input results in an error with code 'INVALID_REQUEST'.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Verifies that valid call log data is correctly parsed and returned.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Tests filtering of call logs based on specific criteria.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Tests pagination functionality by limiting and offsetting results.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Ensures default parameters are applied when null is passed.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Tests handling of call logs with null fields, ensuring proper serialization.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Verifies that limit and offset are constrained within valid bounds before executing search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures that search failures are mapped to an 'unavailable' error response.
